filename: T1 - Tentorial meningioma posterior fossa , tentorium cerebelli 002.jpg
description:
A posterior fossa extra-axial mass demonstrates low SI on T1 and intermediate SI on T2 and avidly enhancing post-Gad administration. The mass shows no restriction on DWI. The mass is broad-based on the right tentorium cerebelli with a small portion shows supratentorial extension, compressing adjacent right cerebellar hemisphere and right occipital lobe. A characteristic dural tail sign is demonstrated on post-Gad sequences.

Partial empty sella turcica.

Prominent arachnoid herniation pit on right occipital bone.
